questions.prompt: This lecture's focus, after politicians, is on what citizens should be—namely:

B That only the UN runs schools.
C That states have no powers.
D That local government is illegal.
questions.explain: Federalism tensions require knowing who to credit/blame.

C Creates a Ministry of Truth.
D Applies only to newspapers in 1791 ink.
questions.explain: First Amendment as open marketplace vs state monopoly propaganda.
